scope: Passive vowel dropping and preservation of removed vowel harmony
findings: Removing drop flags in isolated roots rejects all9 tested contracted passive forms and accepts the9 uncontracted forms; this is not a valid blanket fix.
With drop flags, isolated savur/kavur produce savrılan/kavrılan rather than savrulan/kavrulan. The removed u no longer seeds harmony; remaining a does.
Production accepts savrulan via separate savrul root; kavrulan rejected in production morphology.
Long correct kavrulanlarımızdan changes to kavrılanlarımızdan in centered typing; five other controls preserved.
limits: Initial no-drop export has18 inputs; corresponding corpus saved separately as no-drop-corpus. Later drop export has20.
Isolated roots omit other metadata, but tested passive-participle path does not require aorist/causative classes.
relation: Distinct harmony-loss consequence within vowel-drop handling; connects rounds110–112 and preceding shortened kavru/savru rejections.
